player_prompt.intro: Kai ne Mai kunnawa {player_id} a cikin Chopsticks. A lokacinka, zaɓi ɗaya daga: + Attack: '[attack M O]' inda M = hannunka (0 ko 1), O = hannun abokin hamayya (0 ko 1). - Hannun abokin hamayya yana ƙaruwa da hannunka; idan > = 5, ya zama 0. + Raba: '[split L R] 'don sake rarraba yatsun ku gaba ɗaya zuwa L da R (L + R = jimlar ku). Amsa daidai da ɗayan waɗannan umarnin.
